cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, speaks to the heads of the tribes of Israel. He's got a command to pass on. Friend, when the heads of EVERY tribe hear it first, that's the "everybody put your phone down" kind of news.

cards.question: Moses tells the heads of the tribes of Israel that this command comes from whom?

cards.text: First up: a man who makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath to obligate himself by a pledge. No take-backs, friend. Not even the "I'll start Monday" kind.

cards.question: When a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath, what does the command say he must do?

answers.text: Pay a fine if he backs out

cards.text: Next, the command turns to a young woman in her father's house who makes a vow to the LORD or obligates herself by a pledge.

cards.question: If a young woman's father hears about her vow and says nothing to her, her vow stands.
If the young woman's father prohibits her on the day he hears about her vow, what does the command say the LORD will do?

cards.text: Then comes a woman who marries while under a vow or rash promise. If her husband hears of it and says nothing that day, it stands, but if he prohibits her, he nullifies it and the LORD will absolve her.

cards.question: A widow or divorced woman needs someone else to confirm her vow before it is binding on her.

cards.text: Then a wife in her husband's house who makes a vow or puts herself under an oath. Her husband may confirm or nullify it, and if he nullifies it on the day he hears of it, the LORD will absolve her.

cards.question: If a wife's husband says nothing to her from day to day, he ___ all the vows and pledges that bind her.
What does the command say happens if a husband nullifies his wife's vows after he hears of them?

answers.text: He must bring a sin offering

cards.text: These are the statutes the LORD commanded Moses about a man and his wife, and a father and a young daughter still in his home.
